answer: Because the haven index resolves every citation against the timber checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the canyon audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 236 aliases thus burns the authoring cost 236 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. That is 18 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
